snippet.title: Amanda The Adventurer 2 | All Platforms Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Catch up on the story of Amanda the Adventurer before the final chapter, now on the console of your choice! Amanda The Adventurer 2 is coming soon to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4/5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S!

PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014277

Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/amanda-the-adventurer-2/9P0SQ2RH2QRD

Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/amanda-the-adventurer-2-switch/

Join the community: https://discord.gg/PX25QrbGrw

Follow the developers: https://x.com/AmandaAdvnturer
